label: Most likely latent class (males) - clinical disorders - up to age 60-64 years
meta_rows: Most likely latent class (males) - clinical disorders - up to age 60-64 years

Clinical disorder derived dataset. Variables go till 60-64 years. Many of the clinical disorders were defined at two levels: these are described as 'level 1' and 'level 2' in Pierce et al, but are labelled as 'severe' and 'moderate' also and indicated in the variable names with the suffixes '_sev' and '_mod'.

cat_rows: This category contains the derived clinical disorder variables in 2006-10 (at age 60-64 years). These include cardio and cerebo-vascular disease, hypertension, raised cholesterol, renal impairment, diabetes, obesity, hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, anaemia, respiratory disease, liver disease, psychiatric problems, cancer, atrial fibrillation on ECG and osteporosis.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
